description: Scale your business across Accra and beyond with autonomous Ceyo AI agents. Dedicated cloud computers, Telegram workflows, and 24/7 web research.
h1: Empower Your Ghanaian Business with Autonomous AI
sub: Deploy personal AI bots with dedicated cloud computers running 24/7. Automate research, web workflows, coding, and client operations seamlessly across Ghana.
audience: Ghanaian founders, import-export managers in Tema, fintech engineers, digital agencies, and remote consultants across Accra and Kumasi.
manifesto: In Ghana's fast-moving commerce, spotty connections and busy schedules shouldn't stall your ambitions. Ceyo bots run on dedicated cloud computers 24/7, researching, coding, and managing operations even while your phone is switched off.

uses.d: Bots navigate clearing websites, monitor shipping manifests, and log container status updates directly into your Google Sheets every morning.
Autonomous web browsers compile real-time commodity prices and FX movements, preparing structured intelligence briefs before business begins.
Agents cross-check competitor storefronts, draft customer invoices, and sync stock across your web stores and Google Drive.
Your cloud coding agent writes, runs, and tests payment integration scripts, deploying web apps without draining your local laptop battery.
Specialist Telegram bots collaborate to parse supplier PDFs, convert multi-currency invoices, and alert your logistics team instantly.
Voice agents qualify inbound project leads, gather requirements, and schedule consultations directly into your Google Calendar.

steps.d: Select your workspace and deploy an isolated cloud computer that operates around the clock.
Integrate Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, and CRMs to automate your everyday communication.
Assign autonomous web browsing, coding, and scheduled daily reports to run hands-free.

chapters.d: While traffic crawls along the Spintex Road, your Ceyo bot scans global market trends and delivers an executive brief to Telegram. Your team arrives at work with every priority already organized.
Your agent handles price comparisons across overseas suppliers, filling vendor inquiry forms using its autonomous browser. It logs every quote directly into a shared team Notion workspace.
Your coding bot compiles and runs Python scripts to process customer order records inside its isolated cloud computer. No overheating laptops or lost progress when power flickers.

Even after you disconnect for the night in East Legon, your bots stay active, managing international client emails and tracking overnight shipments. They notify you only when critical decisions require your voice.

faq.q: How do Ceyo pricing plans and the free trial work in Ghana?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three simple tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. A payment card is linked upon registration and is only charged once the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots keep working if my phone loses power or internet?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot runs inside its own isolated cloud computer, completely independent of your local machine. Power outages or network drops in Accra will not disrupt scheduled workflows, scraping runs, or background code executions.

faq.q: Can I manage my AI agents directly through Telegram?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can chat with your personal bot one-on-one or add multiple bot specialists into a Telegram group chat. They collaborate openly, share documents, and complete coordinated tasks right in your chat feed.

faq.q: What languages and communication styles can Ceyo handle?
faq.a: Ceyo agents converse fluently in English and adapt comfortably to Ghanaian business vernacular and common local context. Bots understand multilingual instructions and can draft professional correspondence, technical documentation, or customer support replies.

faq.q: What tasks can the autonomous browser handle without my input?
faq.a: The autonomous browser can log into secure portals, extract table data, fill registration forms, and research competitor prices. It handles complex, multi-page workflows on the web and saves structured summaries back to your connected cloud apps.
